name: GitLab
whyPeoplePay: GitLab sells the whole software delivery surface: Git hosting, CI, packages, security scanners and permissions in one product, billed per seat so engineering headcount is the invoice. People pay to avoid assembling that toolchain themselves.

plans.name: Premium
plans.note: List price $29 per user per month billed annually on about.gitlab.com/pricing (read 2026-08-07).

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.note: Sales-led on the live pricing page: a custom-pricing contact path, not a number. $99 per user per month is the widely published list figure; treat it as unconfirmed until sales quotes you.

pricing.note: Premium is $29 per user/month billed annually on the public pricing page (fetched 2026-08-07). Ultimate is sales-led with no public figure, so it is recorded quote-only here; $99/user/month circulates as the list figure but did not appear on the page. Self-hosted Gitea replaces Git hosting and light PR workflow far more than the full DevSecOps suite.

ranked.rationale: A lightweight self-hosted forge for repos, issues and PRs. One container with SQLite for personal scale; not a feature clone of GitLab Premium CI and security scanners.

evaluatedNotTested.name: Forgejo
evaluatedNotTested.note: Community hard fork of Gitea (soft fork from late 2022, hard fork decision early 2024 under Codeberg e.V.). Actively released (v15 line in 2026). License moved from MIT toward GPL-3.0-or-later for new work while retaining MIT on older code. Surveyed only this pass; not yet ranked.

evaluatedNotTested.name: GitLab CE
evaluatedNotTested.note: Fuller GitLab experience, much heavier ops: a multi-service Omnibus install far beyond the one-container pick ranked on this page.
